EN:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Aw, barbells{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I wanted to challenge
these guys to a swimming contest, 
but I got denied.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Ay{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Podría estar entrenándome
en la piscina durante años y sé que
jamás conseguiría superarlos...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Nom d'un hibou-daim{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}J'ai demandé s'il était possible de
faire un petit 400 mètres nage libre
contre les poissons...
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}... mais le conservateur m'a dit que
l'usage des aquariums était interdit
au public !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Per tutti i dorsali{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Volevo entrare
in acqua a fare due bracciate,
ma me l'hanno vietato.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Oh Mann!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Verflixte Barben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Mit denen wollte ich mal um die
Wette schwimmen.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Aber dann wollten die, dass ich
mich erst mal für die Goldfisch-Liga
qualifiziere!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Pah!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Ah, dambıllar aşkına{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bunlara yüzme
yarışı teklif edecektim ama reddedildim.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I am so going to master that kind of
swimming!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You better believe it!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Un jour, je surpasserai ces petits
gars à la nage !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu vas voir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Un giorno nuoterò esattamente
come loro!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Vedrai!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Irgendwann werde ich genauso gut
schwimmen wie die Flossenviecher
da drin!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Verlass dich drauf!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}O yüzme stilini kesin öğreneceğim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Hiç şüphen olmasın!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}You could do a lot of laps in a big
tank like that!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Con ese acuario tan grande,
¡la de largos que podría hacer!
Si fuera un pez, vamos...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Y'a moyen de faire un paquet de
longueurs dans un bassin aussi
grand !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Vorrei avere anche io una vasca
grande come queste!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Im großen Aquarium kann man viele
Runden schwimmen...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0002:}}Und wenn ein
Hai drin ist, schnelle dazu!
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Öyle büyük bir tankta kaç tur atılır var ya!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}They say all creatures have their
origins in the ocean.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} But I can't
remember that at all!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dicen que todos los seres vivos
vienen del mar...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Oye, ¡pues yo no
recuerdo nada de eso, de verdad!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Il paraît que tout ce qui est vivant,
nous compris, vient de l'océan.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Perso, j'ai beau essayer de m'en
souvenir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ça ne me dit vraiment
rien en ce qui me concerne !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si dice che tutti gli esseri viventi
vengano dal mare.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Io però non mi
ricordo di essere venuto da lì.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Es heißt doch, dass alle Lebewesen
aus dem Ozean stammen, oder?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Und wieso erinnert sich dann keiner
mehr dran!?

EN:
Fish have it easy.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} They never have
to take baths!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Makes me jealous!
FR:
On peut dire que les poissons ont
plutôt la belle vie !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Vu qu'ils sont tout le temps dans
l'eau{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ils auront jamais besoin de
prendre une douche après le sport !
IT:
I pesci sono fortunati.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Non devono
mai farsi la doccia dopo essersi
allenati!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Voglio essere come loro!
TRANSLATION:
Balıkların işi kolay.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Hiç banyo yapmak
zorunda değiller!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kıskandım!
